recipes.title: Five-ingredient egg fried rice
recipes.description: Demo community recipe using ingredients from this pantry's sample inventory.
steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Fry onion and carrot until soft.
Add rice and peas, stir-fry 5 min.
Return eggs, season with soy sauce.

recipes.title: Arroz con frijoles negros
recipes.description: Like my abuela's, but with pantry staples. Feeds four.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and beans with liquid; simmer 10 min.
Cook rice separately and serve beans on top.

recipes.title: Weeknight masoor dal
recipes.description: Demo recipe: red lentils cook fast, and cumin is an easy optional addition.
steps: Rinse lentils and simmer in 3 cups water for 15 min.
Fry onion and garlic until golden.
Stir in tomatoes, then the lentils.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Ginger chicken congee
recipes.description: Comfort food for cold Boston mornings.
steps: Simmer rice in 6 cups water with sliced ginger.
Add chicken after 20 min.
Cook until creamy, shred chicken.
Top with scallions and soy sauce.

recipes.title: Dorm-room peanut butter oats
recipes.description: Demo recipe designed for a microwave and a short ingredient list.
steps: Microwave oats in milk for 2 min.
Stir, then top with banana and peanut butter.

recipes.title: Pantry shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in spicy tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Cook onion and pepper until soft.
Add tomatoes and garlic; simmer 10 min.
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover until set.

recipes.title: Potato lentil soup
steps: Sweat onion and carrot.
Add diced potatoes, lentils and 5 cups water.
Simmer 30 min and season.

recipes.title: Crispy tofu & broccoli stir fry
recipes.description: Demo recipe built around broccoli and tofu in the sample inventory.
steps: Press and cube tofu; pan-fry until crisp.
Stir-fry broccoli and carrots.
Toss together with soy sauce, serve with rice.
